profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: San Diego County, California, United States
profile.summary: As a Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience, I excel in designing and implementing innovative solutions using the latest technologies. My expertise includes Object-Oriented Analysis and Design Concepts, design patterns, and technologies such as C#, .NET 5/6, Angular 12+, REST APIs, ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, React, Microsoft SQL Server, and Oracle. I also have extensive experience in creating Business Intelligence solutions utilizing Microsoft SQL Server’s SSIS, SSRS, and SSAS. With strong leadership and management skills, I consistently deliver high-quality software solutions on time and within budget.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Skills: Technical Leadership · Software Architecture · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Software Design · REST APIs · .NET Core

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
•	Designing and implementing the front-end using Angular 12 to create an intuitive and responsive user interface.
•	Developing the back end using C#, .NET 5/6, and Microsoft SQL Server to ensure efficient data processing and storage.
•	Maintained existing applications, troubleshooting complex system issues to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
•	Participated in data migration, decommissioning, and deactivation planning following mergers and acquisitions.
•	Using SSIS to migrate data from the client’s legacy systems to the new platform to help support reporting and analytics needs.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · REST APIs · OOAD · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)

positions.title: VP, BIA Systems Architect
positions.description:
•	Developed a rapid application development framework with advanced features such as security, workflow, notifications, document and role management to accelerate the delivery of new applications.
•	Engineered a workflow engine using WF 4.5, WCF and C# to support long running and complex business processes.
•	Built fast and flexible user interfaces using Angular 12+, Angular Material UI, ASP.NET MVC and various JavaScript libraries to enhance user experience and satisfaction.
•	Created and implemented web applications using Angular 12+, ASP.NET MVC, C#, WCF, REST APIs and Microsoft SQL Server to meet business requirements and specifications.
•	Developed reusable components that could be shared across applications and teams as a service using WCF and Web APIs (.NET 5/6) to reduce development time and cost.
•	Set up a CI/CD pipeline for internal projects using TFS and Azure to automate testing and deployment processes.
•	Delivered solutions to improve and develop business processes and applications for clients across various domains.
•	Mentored junior team members and contractors on multiple projects to foster a collaborative and productive work environment.
•	Applied various design patterns and object-oriented design concepts in application development to ensure code quality and maintainability.
•	Conducted research and developed proof of concepts using modern technologies to create next-generation applications for the business unit.
•	Integrated existing web applications with internal services and business processes to streamline workflows and data exchange.
•	Imported data from a centralized data warehouse to build local databases using SSIS and Microsoft SQL Server 2008/2012/2014 to support data analysis and reporting.
•	Maintained existing applications, including troubleshooting complex system issues to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · C# · ASP.NET MVC · SSIS · Microsoft SQL Server · Angular · REST APIs · jQuery

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
•	Developed a full-stack web application using ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, C#, WCF, Windows Services and Microsoft SQL Server technologies, following best practices and design patterns.
•	Enhanced the user experience of the web application by implementing a dynamic rotating news control using various jQuery UI widgets and custom CSS styles.
•	Integrated the web application with multiple enterprise systems using RESTful APIs and WCF services.
•	Provided external data for the web application from diverse sources using a WCF service with JSON and XML serialization.
•	Implemented a robust data access layer for the web application using Microsoft Entity Framework and Generic Repository pattern, ensuring code reusability and maintainability.
•	Improved the testability and performance of the web application by using Autofac dependency resolver for .NET to manage dependencies.
•	Developed high-performance backend components (T-SQL, Stored Procedures, Views, UDF’s) with SQL Server 2005, optimizing queries and ensuring data integrity.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET MVC · Microsoft SQL Server · Entity Framework · REST APIs · .NET Framework · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) · jQuery

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed an intuitive enterprise web application UI using C#, ASP.NET MVC, MVCContrib Grouping / HTML grid, WCF, jQuery, Angular JS.
•	Leveraged Microsoft SQL Server 2005, SSIS and SSRS to develop e-Delivery batch tracking solution.
•	Implemented an interface to connect and publish files to the ATOMS (Documentum cloud services) using C#, .NET 4.0, REST API.
•	Created Reader / Writer MQ interfaces with .NET 4.0, C#, IBM WebSphere MQ 7.1 for integration project with third party.
•	Performed application performance analysis with ANTS Memory/Performance profiler before moving to next phase of application.
•	Collaborated effectively with various technology stakeholders (Analysts, Architects and business teams) in designing innovative solutions.
•	Configured MQ SSL for windows on CIT/SIT environment for SSL communication.
•	Developed WCF service to publish messages to MQ and connect to AS400/DB2 for message processing.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET MVC · Web Services · SSIS · Microsoft SQL Server · REST APIs · .NET Framework · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) · JavaScript · WebSphere MQ · jQuery

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
•	Developed a robust and scalable web application for business operations using cutting-edge technologies such as C#, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC MS entity framework and Microsoft SQL Server.
•	Developed a generic utility for exporting data to Excel using C# and Windows Service.
•	Designed and implemented a warehouse solution using BizTalk, C# and Microsoft SQL Server to optimize data storage and retrieval.
•	Designed and executed data migration strategies from different applications on the CIT servers using Info Lease batch processes, SSIS and SQL Agents.
•	Leveraged Factory and Inversion of Control design patterns during application development to enhance code reusability and maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET MVC · SSIS · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET Framework · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented a range of enterprise business applications using cutting-edge technologies such as C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, and ASP.NET MVC.
•	Designed and developed databases using Microsoft SQL Server 2005, including TSQL stored procedures, views, and table schema design.
•	Developed customizable and efficient business processes using Windows Workflow (WF).
•	Created a utility that analyzes IIS Logs and generates reports on webpage response times using LogParser, SSIS, and SSRS 2005.
•	Developed customizable and efficient business processes using Windows Workflow (WF).
•	Improved application performance by de-normalizing database objects and refactoring code to redesign QUEUE functionality, reducing response times from over 30 seconds to just 2 seconds.
•	Collaborated closely with business teams, solution architects, and data architects to provide solutions, estimations, and maintenance release timelines.
•	Led and mentored an offshore support team to resolve technical issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented a range of enterprise business applications using cutting-edge technologies such as C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, and ASP.NET MVC.
•	Utilized advanced design patterns such as Web Client Software Factory (WCSF) and Web Services Software Factory to enhance application development.
•	Adhered to object-oriented design principles and implemented various design patterns such as IoC, Factory, and Singleton to optimize application design and development.
•	Created a utility that analyzes IIS Logs and generates reports on webpage response times using LogParser, SSIS, and SSRS 2005.
•	Designed and developed databases using Microsoft SQL Server 2005, including TSQL stored procedures, views, and table schema design.
•	Implemented Microsoft Enterprise library blocks for robust logging and exception handling across the application.
•	Utilized HP OpenView Performance Manager and Vantage Analysis Server (VAS) for comprehensive application performance monitoring and improvement.
•	Followed the SDLC life cycle of the project using Microsoft TFS (Team Foundation Server) for efficient application design and development.
